name: Scenario 1 — Traffic + Pollution (HITEC City / Madhapur)
title: Severe peak-hour congestion near Inorbit junction
description: Severe peak-hour congestion on the HITEC City corridor (Inorbit junction and Cyber Towers) with associated pollution concerns. Vehicles take 20+ minutes to cross the junction area during office hours. Demonstrates Traffic + Pollution agent collaboration and trade-off analysis.
expects: Referral to Hyderabad Traffic Police / GHMC / TSPCB

name: Scenario 2 — Energy (Gachibowli)
title: High peak electricity demand and repeated interruptions
description: Gachibowli experiences high peak electricity demand and repeated interruptions. The demo energy dataset contains a feeder whose peak demand (48.5 MW) runs near its installed capacity (52 MW). Demonstrates the authority-clarification workflow: AI requests TSSPDCL data, planner approves, simulated authority responds, AI refines the recommendation.

name: Scenario 3 — General Urban Infrastructure / Waste (Charminar)
title: Garbage pile-up near the heritage precinct
description: A citizen complaint reports uncollected garbage near the Charminar heritage precinct affecting sanitation and the heritage experience. Demonstrates that the architecture detects when an appropriate specialist agent is not available and requests one ('Additional domain specialist required'), routed to GHMC Solid Waste Management.
expects: Extensibility point for a Solid Waste Agent
